# illumio-cloudsecure_gcp_flow_logs_pubsub_topic (Resource)

Manages CloudSecure access to flow logs in a GCP Pub/Sub topic.

> [!NOTE]
> `illumio-cloudsecure_gcp_flow_logs_pubsub_topic` is a low-level resource. For most use cases, prefer [the `gcp_flow_logs_pubsub_topic` module](https://registry.terraform.io/modules/illumio/cloudsecure/illumio/latest/submodules/gcp_flow_logs_pubsub_topic)
> (see [an example](https://github.com/illumio/terraform-illumio-cloudsecure/tree/main/examples/gcp_flow_logs_pubsub_topic)),
> which combines this resource together with other resources required for onboarding.
> This resource is intended for module authors and advanced users who need fine-grained control over
> the configuration lifecycle, want to compose registration with custom permissions, or are building
> higher-level abstractions on top of CloudSecure primitives.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "illumio-cloudsecure_gcp_flow_logs_pubsub_topic" "managed_flow_log_pubsub_topic" {
  project_id      = "my-gcp-project-id"
  pubsub_topic_id = "projects/my-gcp-project-id/topics/my-flow-logs-topic"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) ID of the GCP project.
- `pubsub_topic_id` (String) Resource ID of the GCP Pub/Sub topic containing flow logs.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) CloudSecure ID.
